expected_issues.title: Switching from selecting only F401/F841 to selecting the entire `F` (Pyflakes) rule famil…
expected_issues.description:
Switching from selecting only F401/F841 to selecting the entire `F` (Pyflakes) rule family will significantly broaden lint coverage (e.g., F821 undefined-name, F811 redefinition, etc.). If the repo still has known F821 violations (as hinted by the removed TODO), CI/lint may start failing unexpectedly. Consider either (1) enabling `F` but explicitly ignoring known-problematic rules for now (e.g., add `lint.ignore += ["F821"]`), or (2) keep a narrower select list until remaining violations are fixed. Also, add a trailing newline at EOF to satisfy POSIX/editor conventions and avoid diff noise.

```suggestion
    # The "F" series in Ruff stands for "Pyflakes" rules.
    # See: https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/rules/#pyflakes-f
    "F",
]

# If there are still legacy violations, consider temporarily ignoring specific rules:
# lint.ignore = ["ALL", "F821"]
```
